summary: Iteration 20: Mobile PWA (/m) + Project Photos (R2) backend endpoints. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass — PWA assets served (/m-manifest.json w/ start_url=/m, scope=/m, icons 192+512; /m-sw.js; /m-icon-*.png); public pages /mobilier and /murs-accent NOT redirected to /m/login (401 interceptor regression OK); invalid credentials rejected (400/401); POST /api/v1/admin/projects/{id}/photos — unknown project→404, unauth→401/403, upload (multipart files + caption)→200 w/ photos[{id,url,caption,uploaded_at,uploaded_by}], photo persisted on GET, timeline event 'photo' added; DELETE /photos/{photo_id}→200 {success:true}, double-delete→404. Frontend: /m/login→redirect to /m/dashboard works; auth guard on /m redirects unauth to /m/login; all key data-testids present (bottom tabs home/leads/projects/invoices/more, topbar notifications w/ unread badge, dashboard quick actions, leads filters & detail actions call/sms/email/gps, projects list → detail w/ status chips, tasks, photo gallery/camera inputs, timeline, edit, Plus menu w/ clients/quotes/install/logout, Clients add bottom sheet form fields + submit). Client form submit successfully creates and returns to /m/clients list (spec said should navigate to client detail — minor UX deviation).

ui_bugs.issue: React-Helmet-Async <link rel='manifest' href='/m-manifest.json'> is NOT injected into document.head on /m pages (verified via document.head.innerHTML on /m dashboard and /m/leads after full render + 2s wait). Theme-color meta renders OK, title updates OK, so Helmet is active — but children-tags under <Helmet title={...}>{children}</Helmet> aren't being appended. Known gotcha when mixing title prop with children. Browsers will NOT offer PWA install prompt, and iOS can't recognize it as installable. m-manifest.json file itself is served fine (200). Suggest refactor to pure children form: <Helmet><title>...</title><link rel='manifest' .../></Helmet>.

integration_issues.issue: After submit, UI navigates back to /m/clients list instead of the newly-created client detail page as spec requires. Backend persist works (TEST_Mobile_Client_i20 created).

action_items: Fix Helmet manifest injection in MobileLayout.jsx MHead: move title into children (<title>…</title>) so <link rel='manifest' href='/m-manifest.json'/> is appended to <head>. Verify by checking document.head.innerHTML on /m after login.
On successful client create via bottom sheet, navigate to /m/clients/:id (client detail) instead of list, matching spec.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_projects.py upload_project_photos uses $push with timeline added only once per batch, not per photo — reasonable; keep it.

upload_project_photos reads whole file into memory before size check (len(content) > 15MB). For 10 files * up to 15MB this can spike memory. Consider streaming or enforce size BEFORE read (via Content-Length) in future.
delete_project_photo returns 404 only when modified_count==0 — this correctly covers both missing project and missing photo cases.
MobileLayout.jsx uses react-helmet-async; prefer children-form for <title> to ensure sibling <link> and <meta> tags are injected reliably.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (28/29 testid checks + flows OK; 1 PWA manifest head issue, 1 minor nav UX)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Mobile_Client_i20 via /m/clients bottom sheet (not auto-deleted — minor). Backend pytest cleans up its own TEST_PhotoClient + TEST_PhotoProject in teardown.
